testimonials.recipient: TUSHAR MTPL, Prachi Mtpl, Punam Mtpl, Ticketing | Prajakta MTPL
testimonials.text:
Dear Tushar , Prachi and team at MTPL

Vacations are always looked forward to...What makes them pleasurable is an assurance that assistance is just a call away( importantly at a foreign land)..to begin with i must say thats what makes MTPL different then other service providers..infact prompt response is MTPLs' “USP”...

This was probably the longest trip that was planned by Tushar for us..never did we felt any difficulty either in the choice of hotels, locations of the sights for our tours all was remarkable and spot on..We felt the planning was fantastic and importantly keeping us in loop all the time and most importantly our budget, making it cost effective, though we always felt that planning UK will be a very costly affair..But You guys proved us wrong, making it pocket friendly and without compromising on quality..

Visiting an unknown land always gets a bit of insecurity and anxiety..this however was not the issue being planned our trip with MTPL..

like all, though this trip has also reached closure, but with happy memories and rejuvenated mind awaiting for planning the next one..

Well Done Tushar and team

lots of regards

Chitra and Deven and off course Shaurya

Sent from my iPhone
